svg.title: Six-Scene Storyboard and Audio Comparison of the Recovery Code Walkthrough Video
svg.desc: Storyboard listing six actual frames from 0s to 31s of the Korean recovery code walkthrough video in sequence. Displays each scene's approximate time, screen stage, whether original audio covers it, and the omission points at the 12–15s failure notice and 20–26s training code notice.
